The '''Argazdan Regent''' was the title for the leader of the [[Myrialites]] during the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] ([[3970 BBY]]&ndash;[[3670 BBY]]).

==History==
Around [[3670 BBY]], the last Argazdan Regent was [[Torphceris]] whose grip over the Redoubt was threatened by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]]. In desperation, he betrayed his "beliefs" in [[Vianism]] by making a pact with a demonic [[Unidentified female Yuuzhan Vong Shaper|alien "artisan-shaper."]] known as a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] which has come from the [[Intergalactic Void]] and displayed much expertise in bioengineering. Torphceris used the alien's expertise to create a bioengineered monster which was buried beneath the legendary [[Slave Pits of Lorrd]]. These Slave Pits were constructed at the cost of the lives of thousands of Lorrdian slaves.
